name: So it's Simple!
detailed_description:
A Relaxing Story-Rich 2D Platformer based on T.C. Aeelah’s heartwarming book.

So it’s Simple! is a gentle 2D platformer inspired by T.C. Aeelah’s beloved children’s book, created especially for young players aged 6 to 10 — particularly for those taking their first steps into gaming. Designed with care, this game contains no violence, no combat, and no survival mechanics. It offers a safe, calming world where imagination, kindness, and curiosity lead the way.

🌊 About the Game

Step into a whimsical and magical world with Ivo, a quiet, curious boy. Alongside a playful fairy — who also happens to be a butterfly’s best friend — Ivo embarks on a journey of exploration, discovery, and helping others.

Ivo isn’t a typical hero. He doesn’t enjoy chewing food, and sometimes even small tasks feel big. But through simple moments — like collecting fruit, listening to waves, or following the breeze — he begins to discover his place in the world.

🧩 Features

• Designed for Young Players: Intuitive controls and thoughtful pacing, perfect for children ages 6–10.

• A Story with Heart: Based on the emotional journey from So it’s Simple, with themes of growth, empathy, and wonder.

• Safe and Non-Violent: No combat, no enemies, no scary mechanics — just kindness, puzzles, and exploration.

• 2D Platforming with Meaning: Jump, run, and interact with the environment in a way that encourages curiosity and creativity.

• Nature-Inspired Art: Soft visuals inspired by childhood dreams and the simplicity of the natural world.

• Emotional Soundscape: An original soundtrack that evolves with the story — from lighthearted joy to gentle reflection.

🌸 Themes & Moods

• Relaxing & Emotional

• Nature, Magic & Discovery

• Wholesome & Meaningful

• Story-Rich Narrative with Heartwarming Moments

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Who Is It For?

• Children (ages 6–10), especially girls who are new to games

• Parents looking for safe, meaningful screen time

• Families wanting to share a quiet gaming experience together

• Fans of cozy, non-violent indie games with a storybook feel

📖 A Book Comes to Life

This isn’t just a game based on a children’s book — it’s a celebration of simplicity, wonder, and the joy of helping others. Whether or not you’ve read So it’s Simple, this game invites you to slow down, breathe, and see the world through a child’s eyes.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
